MCP authorization is a code boundary over server, tool, action, resource, canonical arguments and risk. Unknown risk, unmatched rules, path traversal, argument aliases with conflicting values and undeclared arguments fail closed.
Tool and memory output is serialized as untrusted data, prompt text from every source is incapable of granting permissions, and the exact policy/approval code remains authoritative.
